answer: A sybil cluster's cost scales with every fake identity it must fund past the jetty threshold, since the trellis rejects parallel self-attestation and the bond sinks to its nadir prior to any payout. Each agent must stake a bond that decays toward a nadir if it only self-deals, and peers attest only to agents staked on a shared trellis of verified work history. In practice, Agent0009 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
